Security verdict: Candidate V3 is NOT MAINNET READY. Full report, source links, reproductions and fixes: docs/SECURITY-REVIEW.md; evidence: docs/TEST-RESULTS.md and docs/audit/PROVENANCE.md. V3 locations below refer to src/experimental/BMCIlluminatiPassCandidateV3.sol at the pinned upstream commit. HIGH H-1 (252-275,302-310): mint 40 Genesis and one mystery NFT, close, request the sole seed, then drop delivery or fail its callback; another request and finalization remain impossible while BMC stays burned. Resolve recovery and fairness together without discarding delivered randomness or burning again. HIGH H-2 (178-205,256-271): cancel the subscription or remove its lane after minting; immutable configuration strands the seed request. Validate operational dependencies before burns and provide reviewed configuration recovery. MEDIUM M-1 (188,191): V3's dynamic CID string cannot fit this manifest ABI, and an expired absolute deadline reverts construction; use a verified constant CID and bounded deployment-relative duration in a separately reviewed revision.

LOW L-1 (V3 callback 302-310; upstream dry-run script:37): a 150000-gas callback succeeds, so V3's 500000 budget unnecessarily raises its funding buffer; measure and right-size V3, retaining margin. Production's callback also finalizes tokens, so its budget is retained. LOW L-2 (308,323-349,424-436): after seed delivery, outcomes are computable while metadata remains pending; expose accurate previews and promptly finalize. LOW L-3 (252-275): close a zero-mint sale and request a useless seed; require sold mystery inventory. LOW L-4: the original Chainlink mock's immediate-funding test does not model service expiry; use the delivered expiry adversarial tests.

Burn/reentrancy checks cover exact payer and total-supply reductions, rejected fake burns, blocked reentry and rollback on receiver rejection. Full-sale tests cover 77 unique Genesis and 423 unique Standard outcomes. V3 rejects minting at its deadline, permits early closure only at sellout, and leaves unsold NFTs unminted; accepted production has no deadline. All 77 Genesis files reproduce the immutable CID; continued IPFS availability requires pinning.

Release limitations: at Mainnet block 26176905 the nominated subscription owner matched the specified owner, with 0 LINK, 0.02 ETH and zero consumers. Consumer registration and adequate subscription funding remain external operator responsibilities. Production's one-day permissionless retries and owner-settable future VRF configuration improve recovery but retain immutable-coordinator dependence, first-delivery ordering risk and possible duplicate subscription charges (src/BMCIlluminatiPass.sol:192-224,261-290,314-324). No unconditional Mainnet approval is implied.
